name: File Studio
description: Work with the files in your Attachments columns: inspections and handovers, customers and contracts, receipts, equipment, applicants. Cards, a wall of files, a list and a viewer. Photos, PDFs, video, audio, text, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files open large; edit pictures (also a Document look for photos of pages), text files and PDFs (reorder, split, merge, fill and sign, fill in forms, make pages into pictures, set a password) and save them in place or as a copy; see where the space goes, shrink photos in bulk and free up space; search the words inside PDFs, Word, Excel and text files, and in scans and pictures by text recognition; tag files and add notes; right-click menus and folders (a folder is a record); see folder sizes; folders inside folders with a folder list; cut, copy and paste files between folders; find anything with Ctrl+K; iPhone (HEIC) pictures in any browser; mark with a box; download one zip of every file; show files as tiles or as a sortable list; make a photo report PDF of a record; slideshow, before/after slider and sort by date taken; see every cell a file sits in; copy, move, rename and zip files named after your columns. Runs entirely in the browser: no server, your files go only between the browser and your Grist.

name: Plan Studio
description: Gantt chart, timeline, board, booking grid and workload over the tables you already keep. Drag a task, a card or a booking and the change is written straight back to your table; level an overloaded plan in one step. Prints to PDF, in English, German or French. Runs entirely in the browser: no server, nothing leaves your document.

name: Advanced Charts
description: Turn a Grist table into a website-style dashboard: KPI cards, every ECharts chart type, group breakdowns, live tables, slicers and maps, edited in place. The design saves into your own Grist document, and your data is never sent anywhere: there is no server. Map blocks fetch tiles from public map providers.

name: Invoice Studio
description: Create, render and send invoices, quotes, receipts, credit notes, statements and delivery notes from the tables you already keep. PDF with embedded fonts, eight document languages, EU reverse charge and small-business exemptions, SEPA/UPI/payment-link QR codes, Factur-X, XRechnung and UBL e-invoices. Runs entirely in the browser: no server, nothing leaves your document.
